scope: Bounded primary-source file audit; no training/model execution, no reproduction scores.

findings: Computes full-vocabulary Shannon entropy from supplied logits with natural logs. This function does not itself declare the actual scoring temperature or sampling truncation.
verl_torch.adapter: Definition template only; no torch/model execution in Lab.
verl_torch.actual_experiment_producer_revision: unknown unless explicitly supplied by caller

findings: Previous actor path is absent at reviewed main. Current FSDP engine and trainer paths were audited instead.
verl_actor.adapter: No support claim for the unavailable file.
verl_actor.actual_experiment_producer_revision: unknown unless explicitly supplied by caller

findings: Relevant forward path scales logits by supplied temperature before entropy calculation. Model entropy at these logits does not imply entropy of the post top-p/top-k sampling distribution.
verl_fsdp.adapter: Actual runtime temperature/support must be supplied by producer.
verl_fsdp.actual_experiment_producer_revision: unknown unless explicitly supplied by caller

findings: Records actor/entropy after agg_loss using response_mask and configured loss_agg_mode/loss_scale_factor. Then removes entropys from old_log_prob batch. calculate_entropy and entropy_coeff control calculation but do not prove recorded samples completed an update.
verl_trainer.adapter: Saved logger dictionary or JSONL wrapper; no token reconstruction.
verl_trainer.actual_experiment_producer_revision: unknown unless explicitly supplied by caller

findings: Returns input_ids, token_texts, obs_logprob, obs_prob, entropy for teacher-forced continuation positions. Next-token logits are shifted and unscaled in this source. compare_scores checks token IDs before comparing. Standard script writes HTML; returned arrays need explicit serialization.
seal_draw_token.adapter: Explicit saved return-object adapter, not a claim of native JSONL export.
seal_draw_token.actual_experiment_producer_revision: unknown unless explicitly supplied by caller

findings: Length-normalized and sequence-summed reasoning log-probability matrices are maintained separately. MI proxy uses a finite mixture across prompt columns. Signed MI samples are retained. Retrieval identifies the original prompt, with prompt-signature handling, rather than evidence retrieval. Metrics are namespaced by first-turn or trajectory sampling.
ragen_collapse.adapter: Reads actual namespaced metric dictionaries; normalized probe rows needed to retain cross-score matrix/protocol.
ragen_collapse.actual_experiment_producer_revision: unknown unless explicitly supplied by caller

findings: Documents sampled reasoning/prompt cross-scoring, scope-specific names, normalization, prompt identification and coverage boundaries.
ragen_mi_docs.adapter: Protocol reference; no MI inference or Search replication performed.
ragen_mi_docs.actual_experiment_producer_revision: unknown unless explicitly supplied by caller

findings: Requests logprobs=10. Collects returned candidates for up to first 20 generated positions, accumulates -p ln p and divides by ln(vocabulary size); does not average over positions or reconstruct the vocabulary tail. current_entropy_dict is internal. Exported meta_info.metrics in this file contains tool metrics. Empty candidates produce an internal zero fallback.
arpo_branch.adapter: Explicit normalized producer-hook rows; no universal native entropy JSON export inferred.
arpo_branch.actual_experiment_producer_revision: unknown unless explicitly supplied by caller

findings: Locates the first search query by text/token boundaries; averages -p_sample log2 p_sample over sampled-token probabilities clamped to [1e-10,1]. Not full-vocabulary entropy and not sampled surprisal. Missing tag or unsupported span returns zero internally.
ssrl_search.adapter: Explicit normalized hook rows with support flags; preserve fallback zero separately from uninterpretable measurement.
ssrl_search.actual_experiment_producer_revision: unknown unless explicitly supplied by caller

findings: Normalizes target then forms 1-target risk, sorts uncertainty ascending using stable input order, and averages prefix risk (default normalize=True). Tied scores can depend on input ordering.
polygraph_risk.adapter: Research reference; Lab defines binary-error tie-expected AURC explicitly rather than claiming byte-equivalent reproduction.
polygraph_risk.actual_experiment_producer_revision: unknown unless explicitly supplied by caller

findings: Marked is_ood_metric=True, forwards target and estimator to sklearn roc_auc_score after missing/inf preprocessing. Positive-class meaning comes from target.
polygraph_auc.adapter: Lab error AUROC uses formal EM error=1 explicitly; OOD labels are not inferred.
polygraph_auc.actual_experiment_producer_revision: unknown unless explicitly supplied by caller

not_upstream_outputs: Serialized SEAL return arrays if not explicitly exported
Per-token veRL entropy when only actor/entropy aggregate was logged
boundaries: Reviewed file hashes identify audited public source bytes, not the revision that produced a user experiment.
No source defaults fill missing actual temperature, tokenizer, masks, prefix, sample identity or costs.
No full logits, future information or labels are invented from scalar entropy.
